outcomeNote: A Tosefta gloss on the mishna's glass measure

segments.he: זְכוּכִית כְּדֵי לִגְרוֹר בָּהּ. תָּנָא: סְכוּכִית — כְּדֵי לִפְצוֹעַ בָּהּ שְׁנֵי נִימִין כְּאַחַת.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: The measure that determines liability for carrying out «glass» is «equivalent» to that which is used «to scrape» and smooth the top of a bobbin. A tanna «taught» that halakha in a Tosefta in a different manner: The measure that determines liability for carrying out «glass» is «equivalent» to that which is used «to cut two threads at once,» as a glass shard can be used in place of a knife.
